title: Sunken Metro: Underground Exploration

foundation.history: A forgotten underwater tram hub once protected recycled batteries, until recurring rising flood gates forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Jori Navin, a spelunker, must map safe evacuation routes, relying on light and spatial memory despite rising flood gates.
central_conflict: an unstable cavern network threatens the underwater tram hub by restricting recycled batteries.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: rising flood gates destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: an unstable cavern network contests access to recycled batteries
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.cause: The underwater tram hub becomes operable
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
